name: Dragonheart
description: You take a bit of a windup, and your attacks tend to be a bit more wild, but all for the better when you land your blows.
effect: All the Physical or Special moves the user uses gain -2 Accuracy on their accuracy checks, however, they gain +2 Base Power. The user chooses at the start of each battle which type of moves this ability affects. Any move that has the Charge Tag gains an additional -1 Accuracy and +2 Power.
